item.title: Illinois Primary Election 2026: Champaign County results and updates - IPM Newsroom
item.description: Though results remain official, Michelle Jett has widened her lead in the race for Champaign County executive, holding more than 60% of the vote. Results remain too close to call on the measure to expand the Mahomet Public Library.

item.title: Andrej Stojakovic scores 21 as No. 3 seed Illinois beats 11th-seeded VCU 76-55 to reach Sweet 16 - IPM Newsroom
item.description: Andrej Stojakovic scored 21 points and No. 3 Illinois beat 11th-seeded VCU 76-55 on Saturday to advance to the Sweet 16 for the second time in three seasons under coach Brad Underwood.

item.title: Illinois beats Colorado for 1st round win as youngest team in women's NCAA Tournament - IPM Newsroom
item.description: Cearah Parchment scored 21 points as seventh-seeded Illinois beat No. 10 seed Colorado 66-57 on Saturday night in the first round of the women’s NCAA Tournament. The Fighting Illini are the youngest team in this tournament after replacing four starters.

item.title: Jet collides with fire truck at New York's LaGuardia Airport. 2 pilots killed - IPM Newsroom
item.description: The crash shut down LaGuardia — the New York region’s third busiest hub — during what was already a messy time at U.S. airports.

item.title: Mass shooting injures 6, including ISU students, in off-campus residential neighborhood - IPM Newsroom
item.description: The victims include two juvenile males, two adult males, and two adult females, police said. Illinois State University Police said in a statement that two of the people injured are ISU students.

item.title: Teenager fatally shot in Champaign after fight outside Market Place Mall - IPM Newsroom
item.description: The Champaign County Coroner said the victim is Jaylen Bailey of Champaign.

item.title: Homer Lake Nature Center addition will bring new classroom to the park - IPM Newsroom
item.description: The district is currently renovating the Homer Lake Interpretive Center.

item.title: Vanderbilt ends Fighting Illini Women's Basketball season - IPM Newsroom
item.description: Mikayla Blakes scored 25 points as No. 2 seed Vanderbilt beat seventh-seeded Illinois 75-57 to advance to the Sweet 16 in the women’s NCAA Tournament for the first time since 2009.Illinois's Sweet 16 drought continues with its last berth in 1998.

item.title: Vanderbilt eliminates Illinois women’s basketball from the March Madness Tournament - IPM Newsroom
item.description: After winning the team’s first round of the March Madness Tournament, the Illinois women’s basketball team was eliminated after losing 75-57 to the No. 2-seeded Vanderbilt Monday night.

item.title: Who can own big cats in America? Fatal tiger attack draws scrutiny to federal rules - IPM Newsroom
item.description: Some animal welfare advocates say federal regulations don’t go far enough to protect these animals and the people interacting with them.
